firmographics.narrative_md: AAFCU is a credit union headquartered in Fort Worth, TX. It reports $9.2 billion in total assets and has operated since 1936. It is regulated by NCUA (National Credit Union Administration) and employs approximately 426 people across 47 branches. Its overall digital maturity is assessed at 2.3 out of 5 across the DMA capability framework.
